name: colorful
label: Colorful
css: .style-colorful { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, var(--slide-secondary, #8B5CF6) 100%); color: var(--slide-text, #111827); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; padding: 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .style-colorful::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; right: -50%; width: 600px; height: 600px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); filter: blur(40px); pointer-events: none; } .style-colorful .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; color: #FFFFFF; text-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); margin-bottom: 24px; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; } .style-colorful .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 85%; } .style-colorful .step { position: absolute; top: 40px; right: 40px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); line-height: 1; z-index: 1; } .style-colorful .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 40px; left: 40px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); letter-spacing: 0.5px; z-index: 2; } .slide-code.style-colorful { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F2937 0%, #111827 100%); color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-code.style-colorful .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .slide-code.style-colorful .text { color: rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.9); } .slide-code.style-colorful .step { color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); } .slide-code.style-colorful .brand { color: rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.5); } .slide-code.style-colorful::before { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05); } .slide-insight.style-colorful { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E1B4B 100%); color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-colorful .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); } .slide-insight.style-colorful .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 32px 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #FFFFFF 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; } .slide-insight.style-colorful .text { color: rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.85); } .slide-insight.style-colorful .step { color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); } .slide-insight.style-colorful .brand { color: rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.6); } .slide-insight.style-colorful::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.1), rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05)); }
